_doc: Every address the 2026 client plugins use, by name. va = the address in the REFERENCE exe (official US 10.6.6, Fiesta.exe TimeDateStamp 6AB41A55 2026-09-23 - rebased from 10.6.4 on 2026-11-07, its exe no longer at hand). kind code = a function or a patch site (found by a signature taken at the address); kind data = a global / string (found through an instruction that references it). Run client_sigs.py (README.md) after an official client update.
